data.name: A Shadow in Space
data.detailed_description:
THE SETTING

Stranded on the GT-099 space station, you will embark on a journey into the unknown, and experience a world of unnamable terrors and ancient, cosmic secrets. Discovering what lurks within the deep void of space will prove to be a test of your sanity...

A THIRD-PERSON IMMERSIVE SIM

Investigate your surroundings, discover important clues, and strategically weigh your options while using the tools at your disposal. Tackle situations with multiple solutions – rely on stealth, your wits, or your weapons. Use the environment to your advantage to overcome obstacles in clever ways.

COSMIC HORROR MEETS SCI-FI

Experience a haunting narrative with surreal, dreamlike elements largely inspired by the works of renowned storytellers H.P. Lovecraft and Edgar Allan Poe. Discover locations both fantastical and futuristic in this unique blend of sci-fi and horror.

A TALE OF TWO PROTAGONISTS

Explore the GT-099 space station from a third-person perspective and uncover its many secrets from the viewpoint of two distinct protagonists, each with their own unique skill sets and abilities. You will...

  • EXPLORE a desolate space station soaked in ancient, cosmic secrets

  • INVESTIGATE the fates of those who came before you, using their knowledge to your advantage

  • DISCOVER what unspeakable truths lurk beyond the veil of our reality

  • FIGHT inconceivable horrors that threaten to unravel your sanity

data.short_description: A Shadow in Space is a narrative-driven third-person immersive sim that combines futuristic sci-fi with Lovecraftian cosmic horror. Discover the ancient secrets of a desolate space station and face the sanity-bending terrors that lurk within the deep void of space.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4790/AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970/AMD RX 480 (4GB VRAM or more)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K/AMD R9-7950X
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 3070 Ti/AMD RX 6800 (8GB VRAM or more)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
